errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns the largest segment (61%, 19.0 mln) to Other services (dark blue) in the 'Number of enterprises' chart. The figure shows Industry (yellow) as 61% (19.0 mln).
The description incorrectly states Industry (yellow) as 7% and 2.2 mln in the 'Number of enterprises' chart. The figure shows Industry as 61% and 19.0 mln.
The description incorrectly states Construction (light blue) as 12% and 3.7 mln in the 'Number of enterprises' chart. The figure shows Construction as 8% and 2.4 mln.
The description incorrectly states Other services (dark blue) as 51% and 88.2 mln in the 'Number of persons employed' chart. The figure shows Industry (yellow) as 51% and 80.2 mln.
The description incorrectly states Industry (yellow) as 21% and 36.9 mln in the 'Number of persons employed' chart. The figure shows Other services (brown) as 21% and 33.0 mln.
The description incorrectly states Construction (light blue) as 9% and 15.8 mln in the 'Number of persons employed' chart. The figure shows Construction as 9% and 13.4 mln.
The description incorrectly states Other services (dark blue) as 34% and 9.8 tn in the 'Turnover' chart. The figure shows Other services (brown) as 33% and 10.6 tn.
The description incorrectly states Industry (yellow) as 33% and 9.6 tn in the 'Turnover' chart. The figure shows Industry (yellow) as 31% and 9.8 tn.
The description incorrectly states Construction (light blue) as 4% and 1.3 tn in the 'Turnover' chart. The figure shows Construction as 6% and 1.9 tn.
The description incorrectly assigns the color dark blue to Other services. The figure shows Other services as brown.
The description does not state the purpose of the chart, which is to show the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021.
The description does not explicitly mention that the sectors are not visually ordered by size, as noted in the reference.
The description refers to the charts as 'donut' diagrams, but the figure shows standard pie charts, not donut charts.
The description omits the title and subtitle of the figure, which provide context about the data being shown for 2021 and the classification standard (NACE Rev. 2).
